mapper.select: INSERT INTO arrival_prediction_observation ( raw_observation_id, vehicle_run_observation_id, boarding_stop_id, requested_alighting_stop_id, alighting_stop_confirmed, alighting_stop_status, expected_at, min_expected_at, max_expected_at, remaining_stops, source, confidence, observed_at, received_at ) VALUES ( #{rawObservationId}, #{vehicleRunObservationId}, #{boardingStopId}, #{requestedAlightingStopId}, #{alightingStopConfirmed}, COALESCE(#{alightingStopStatus}, 'UNKNOWN'), #{expectedAt}, #{minExpectedAt}, #{maxExpectedAt}, #{remainingStops}, #{source}, #{confidence}, #{observedAt}, #{receivedAt} ) RETURNING id
